title: Adversarial Robustness of Phishing Email Detection: A Comparative Study of TF-IDF + Logistic Regression and Fine-Tuned DistilBERT
abstract: arXiv:2607.18429v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Phishing emails remain one of the most persistent cybersecurity threats, and machine-learning classifiers are widely used to detect them. Most reported detection accuracies, however, are measured on clean, in-distribution test data rather than on emails deliberately altered to evade detection. This paper reports a controlled, pairwise comparison of two phishing-detection approaches a TF-IDF + Logistic Regression baseline and a fine-tuned DistilBERT transformer trained on a unified corpus of 82,255 emails drawn from six public datasets and evaluated under three conditions: normal in-distribution, synthetic phishing, and adversarial phishing. translated_title: 钓鱼邮件检测的对抗鲁棒性：TF-IDF+逻辑回归与微调DistilBERT的对比研究
translated_abstract: 钓鱼邮件仍然是最持久的网络安全威胁之一，机器学习分类器被广泛用于检测它们。然而，大多数报告的检测准确率是在干净、分布内的测试数据上测量的，而不是在故意修改以逃避检测的邮件上。本文报告了两种钓鱼检测方法的受控配对比较：TF-IDF+逻辑回归基线和微调DistilBERT变换器，两者在来自六个公共数据集的82,255封邮件的统一语料库上训练，并在三种条件下评估：正常分布内、合成钓鱼和对抗钓鱼。两种模型在干净数据上均超过98%的准确率，但在对抗测试下急剧下降：TF-IDF+LR降至64.00%（下降34.59个百分点），DistilBERT降至63.64%（下降35.40个百分点），两者差距仅为0.36个百分点，相当于2封邮件中的1封。
tldr: 本研究通过对比TF-IDF+逻辑回归与微调DistilBERT在钓鱼邮件检测中的表现，发现两者在干净数据上均超过98%准确率，但在对抗攻击下均急剧下降至约64%，揭示了当前检测方法在对抗环境中的脆弱性。
en_tdlr: This study compares TF-IDF+Logistic Regression and fine-tuned DistilBERT for phishing email detection, finding both exceed 98% accuracy on clean data but drop sharply to ~64% under adversarial attacks, revealing vulnerability in current detection methods.
